3gpp-ts-22.186-v16.2.0.declined_claim: No advanced-driving requirement class spanning 100–500 ms was verified. The 500 in advanced-driving requirement R.5.3-006 denotes metres of communication range, not milliseconds. A 500 ms latency requirement belongs to platooning reporting R.5.2-008 in Table 5.2-1, printed page 9.
3gpp-ts-22.186-v16.2.0.manuscript_handling: Cites the verified 100 ms requirement, distinguishes communications from task-completion deadlines, and retains a bracketed owner note about the unverified spanning class. Uses the title of the inspected version, not an unverified title from the prompt.
